title: I got tired of checking 10 different sites to understand the market, so I built my own global AI market dashboard
author: dvysrm
selftext:
I’ve been messing around with markets and building finance tools for a while, and one thing kept annoying me.

If I wanted to check the S&P 500, then gold, then EUR/USD, then crude oil, then the DAX, I’d end up jumping between a bunch of different websites and charts. One site for prices, another for indicators, another for news, another for index constituents.

So back in April I started building something for myself.

That eventually turned into **GlobalQuantAI**.

The basic idea is pretty simple: put global indices, commodities and forex pairs into one system and give each asset the same quantitative treatment instead of having to manually interpret 50 different charts.

Right now it tracks 176 markets, including major indices, commodities and forex pairs.

The part I spent the most time on was the signal engine.

Every asset is analyzed independently and the system recalculates every 15 seconds across **5 timeframes**:

**1m → 5m → 15m → 1h → 1D**

So rather than just saying “gold is bullish”, you can see whether the very short-term move agrees with the broader trend.

The signal is built from a mix of things like:

* RSI
* MACD
* EMA 9/20/50 alignment
* Bollinger Bands
* Stochastic
* Relative volume

Then it turns all of that into a simple **UP / DOWN / HOLD** read with a confidence score.

The multi-timeframe part is probably my favorite because it catches situations where, for example, the 1-minute chart looks bullish but the 1-hour and daily trend are still pointing the other way.

I also added AI-assisted news intelligence and constituent-stock views for indices, because I wanted to go beyond just looking at a giant candle chart.

Some of the asset pages:

**US markets**  
[S&P 500](https://globalquantai.com/indices/sp500/)  
[Nasdaq 100](https://globalquantai.com/indices/nasdaq100/)

**European / Asian markets**  
[DAX](https://globalquantai.com/indices/dax/)  
[Nikkei 225](https://globalquantai.com/indices/nikkei-225/)

**Commodities**  
[Gold](https://globalquantai.com/commodities/gold/)  
[Silver](https://globalquantai.com/commodities/silver/)  
[WTI Crude Oil](https://globalquantai.com/commodities/wti-crude/)  
[Brent Crude Oil](https://globalquantai.com/commodities/brent-crude/)

**Forex**  
[EUR/USD](https://globalquantai.com/forex/eur-usd/)  
[GBP/USD](https://globalquantai.com/forex/gbp-usd/)  
[USD/JPY](https://globalquantai.com/forex/usd-jpy/)  
[DXY](https://globalquantai.com/forex/dollar-index/)

Everything is free to use and there’s no login requirement.

I’m not claiming an AI signal can predict markets perfectly. It absolutely can’t. The point for me was to build a consistent way of reading a huge number of markets without manually going through indicators one by one.

I’d genuinely be interested in hearing what traders think of the approach, especially the multi-timeframe model. What would you add to something like this?
